issues: Milestone card TITLES ('Not Submitted', 'Pending', 'Ai Review', 'Admin Review', 'Approved', 'Rejected', 'More Info Required') and eta_labels ('Awaiting secure submission', 'Queued for intake validation', ...) remain English in French locale. These strings are supplied by the backend `label` field in id_checker.timeline.milestones and are not routed through the i18n label maps. The status chips (Actuel / À VENIR) and workflow-stage chips (Non soumis, En attente de révision, En cours de révision IA, En cours de révision admin, Approuvé) ARE localized correctly. Recommend: map milestone.state → localized label on the client instead of consuming backend label field, or localize labels on the backend based on Accept-Language.
Small orange banner 'Detected locale suggests EN. Tap to align language preferences.' is itself only in English even when user preference is French. Low priority.
